---
applyTo: "tests/**/*.py,src/**/*.py,scripts/**/*.py"

# Testing Instructions

- Use docs/ai/testing-strategy.md as the canonical test policy.
- Prioritize deterministic tests with explicit seeds where needed.
- Add regression tests for verified bug fixes.
- Ensure changed behavior is covered by unit or integration tests.
- Verify task completion against docs/ai/definition-of-done.md.
